explanation: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Amiens (1597)" (revision 1374174871) says: "As a result of the victory, Henry was in a strong position to enact the Edict of Nantes and to negotiate the peace of Vervins which was signed with Spain the following spring." The edge reads that sentence as: Siege of Amiens (1597) made Peace of Vervins possible, and nothing more.
